items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: The interviewee discusses Duke Ellington in the context of purchasing tunes and composing credits, but does not describe a personal interaction or professional collaboration with Duke Ellington himself.

ctx.x: And I know once Barney Bigard told me that Duke, as he called him, had bought several of those tunes from Lorenzo Tio. Tio. That's right. Because Tio went up there with Piron to New York. That's right. And stayed there a few years after Piron came back.
And he sold it to Duke Ellington. Sophisticated Lady and there's something about a mood.
